title: Contoso Sustainable Income Fund — May 2026 factsheet
content: Strategy: Investment-grade EUR-denominated credit and sovereign exposure with an ESG floor at 7.5. Trailing 12-month yield 3.4%. Manager has slightly extended duration into the recent ECB rate-cut window (effective duration 5.8y vs 5.2y prior). Top sector exposures: sovereign 38%, IG financials 22%, IG industrials 18%. ESG score 8.2 (composite). Notable: fund underweights Russell-screened thermal coal issuers since 2024-Q1 reweighting.
